preferenceSummary.description: Spot agreements, hesitation and genuine friction without exposing anyone’s individual choices.
preferenceSummary.noBlindMajority: An objection remains visible even when several people want the attraction. The group then decides explicitly.
preferenceSummary.noDecision: No group decision has been recorded yet.
preferenceSummary.reasonHint: A reason is required and stays visible with the decision author.
preferenceSummary.empty: Add a park to the trip first to build the compass.

signals.priority: This attraction stands out as a priority with no stated objection.
signals.incomplete: {{count}} answer(s) are still missing, so compatibility remains provisional.

feedback.saveError: The decision could not be saved.
